Name: Pixel Waifu Reminiscens - Parchment
Author: MasterRoshiHEHE
Description:
[quote][b]WARNING: WORK IN PROGRESS & EXTREMELY NSFW[/b] Listen well, young turtle! This mod is incredibly Work In Progress (WIP) and far from finished, containing a massive stash of highly NSFW material that will make your nose bleed.[/quote]Word around Pelican Town is that the local merchants have started selling a rather intriguing bundle: a classic 90s-style Polaroid camera and a completely empty, leather-bound scrapbook. As a virile young farmer, it is your duty to venture out into the valley and fill those blank pages with breathtaking, personal memories.
[b]The Art of the Scrapbook[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Dynamic Progression:[/b] When you acquire the book, it is completely blank. As you naturally progress your relationships and trigger special heart events, new Polaroids will magically develop and sort themselves chronologically into your album.[/*]
[*][b]Interactive Gallery:[/b] Your memories begin as charming, low-resolution pixel thumbnails on a structured page grid. Clicking on a Polaroid rewards you with a glorious, high-resolution HD pop-up. The book's index will even dynamically expand to add new names as you succeed in your conquests.[/*]
[*][b]Lore-Friendly Lewdness:[/b] The scenarios remain entirely true to the spirit of the valley, just wonderfully spicier. You will capture candid moments of the girls in highly contextual outfits, from morning pyjamas to revealing summer beachwear.[/*]
[*][b]Current Beauties:[/b] Building a masterpiece takes time. Right now, the collection focuses heavily on our lovely Haley, with only a few other valley girls slowly making their debut in the framework.[/*]
[*][b]The Perfect Pairing:[/b] This interactive photo album was built specifically to be used alongside my main HD portrait overhaul, [b]Pixel Waifu Ripening[/b].[/*]
[/list][b]A Word of Advice[/b]
Now, a strict word of advice from your master: do not go peeking directly into the mod's image folders! You will only spoil the magnificent surprises waiting to be earned.
If you ever find yourself stuck, simply open your [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (MCM)[/b]. From there, you can toggle a special setting to reveal subtle, flavor-text hints directly on the empty scrapbook placeholders to guide your next romantic photoshoot.
Get out there and start snapping!

Expect bugs, filler text and unfinished ideas!
And remember to check the requirements!
